messages.subject: Color in clusterSamples and PCASamples are not synced with treatment types
parts:
Dear all,

I have two group of Treatment vs Control samples. When I do PCA and clustering of samples some of control samples get the same color as treatment samples. Anyone can help me here?

Many thanks in advance,Rahel

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Color in clusterSamples and PCASamples are not synced with treatment types
parts: make sure that the treatment vector and your samples have the same order, otherwise sample group annotations can be mismatched. If you are making sure of that, please send a reproducible example
